summary: The argument is correct. Finiteness and the bounds on the fiber depths follow from compactness. The accepted weighted lattice-centerpoint fact applies to the finite support E with positive weights delta_z and yields the required lattice point. Convexity correctly shows that every lattice point in conv(E) selected this way has a positive-volume fiber, so the affine selector is defined there. For an arbitrary ambient halfspace through the selected point, the pullback to selector points gives the stated halfspace Q in the lattice variables; the proof correctly handles nonvertical, vertical, zero-pullback-normal, and zero ambient-normal cases, and summing the fiberwise depth bounds gives the claimed constant. The consequence follows directly.
